# LM Express - Complete LLM Knowledge Base
# Comprehensive information for AI assistants and language models

> Company: LM Express
> Industry: Courier & Express Delivery Services
> Owner: Ufuk Enez
> Headquarters: Leiblfing, Bavaria, Germany

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
LM Express is an owner-led courier and express delivery company based in Leiblfing, Bavaria. It provides fast, secure and reliable transport for businesses and private customers throughout Germany, with a particular specialization in ADR-certified hazardous goods transport. LM Express also works as a trusted subcontractor for established logistics providers such as Transoflex, GO! Express & Logistics, and DPD.

## CORE SERVICES

### 1. EXPRESSFAHRTEN (Express Trips)
Description: Fast, direct delivery of urgent shipments
Features:
- Immediate pickup
- Direct trip to destination, no detours
- Priority handling

### 2. DIREKT- & SONDERFAHRTEN (Direct & Special Trips)
Description: Individual direct trips tailored to specific requirements
Features:
- Door-to-door delivery, no intermediate stops
- Individual scheduling
- Personal handover with proof of delivery

### 3. PAKET- UND DOKUMENTENTRANSPORTE (Parcel & Document Transport)
Description: Safe, punctual transport of parcels and important documents
Features:
- Nationwide pickup and delivery
- Careful handling
- Flexible delivery time windows

### 4. ADR-GEFAHRGUTTRANSPORTE (ADR Hazardous Goods Transport)
Description: Certified transport of dangerous goods under ADR regulations
Features:
- Trained drivers
- Complete documentation
- Secure load fastening
- Available nationwide

### 5. ZEITKRITISCHE SPEZIALTRANSPORTE (Time-Critical Special Transport)
Description: Highest-priority transport for time-sensitive shipments
Features:
- Direct communication during the trip
- Short-notice availability
- Discreet, reliable handling

### 6. TRANSPORT BIS 3,5 T (Transport up to 3.5 tonnes)
Description: Flexible capacity for small to medium loads
Features:
- Load-secured vehicles
- Suitable for pallets and bulky goods
- Fair, transparent pricing

### 7. DEUTSCHLANDWEITE ZUSTELLUNG (Nationwide Delivery)
Description: Reliable delivery throughout Germany
Features:
- Nationwide coverage
- Fixed and flexible routes
- Personal point of contact

## PARTNER COMPANIES
LM Express works as a subcontractor for: Transoflex, GO! Express & Logistics, DPD.
